name: Hotel Tenne Garni
beschreibung: The Hotel Tenne Garni is located in the center of Söll, a village in the Wilder Kaiser region of Tirol. The accommodation offers bed and breakfast and is ideal for guests who want to explore the surrounding area. Söll belongs to the Wilder Kaiser ski area region and is popular as both a summer and winter destination. Hiking trails and ski slopes are within easy reach. The hotel is simply furnished and caters to travelers looking for straightforward accommodation.
